Select Theme

    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Avatar
    A circular avatar: a picture, or the initials of a name on a color derived from the name.
    Badge
    A small pill-shaped label for a status or a count.
    Badge.Kind
    The color of a badge.
    BreadcrumbBar
    A path of clickable items separated by chevrons; the last item is the current location (bold, not clickable).
    BreadcrumbBar.ItemClickListener
    Receives clicks on the items.
    ButtonStyle
    Visual variants of buttons.
    Card
    A surface with a rounded border and an optional header.
    ColorPickerPane
    A color picker panel: a saturation / brightness square, a hue slider, an optional opacity slider, a hex field, RGB(A) number boxes and a row of swatches.
    ContentDialog
    A modal dialog drawn over the window's own content (with a dimmed backdrop), for confirmations and short forms.
    ContentDialog.Result
    How the dialog was closed.
    DropDownButton
    A button whose whole surface opens a menu, with a chevron at the end.
    Expander
    A header that shows or hides a content area, with an animated chevron.
    FileBrowser
    A file browser pane: breadcrumb address bar (click the empty part to type a path), places sidebar, back / forward / up / new folder, list, details and tile views, extension filters, and a name field.
    FileBrowser.Mode
    What the browser is used for.
    FileBrowser.ViewMode
    How the files of a folder are shown.
    Fonts
    Font helpers.
    Icon
    A vector glyph from the Tessel icon set.
    InfoBar
    An inline message with a severity: informational, success, warning or error.
    NavigationView
    The main navigation of an app: a pane of items on the left (collapsible to an icon rail) and the selected page next to it.
    NavigationView.Item
    A navigation entry.
    NumberBox
    Number input with step buttons, a range, and arithmetic: type 12 * 3 + 4 and press Enter.
    NumberBox.SpinButtonPlacement
    Where the step buttons are drawn.
    Palette
    The colors of a Tessel theme.
    ProgressRing
    A circular progress indicator.
    ProgressState
    The state of a progress bar or progress ring: the normal accent color, paused (warning), failed (error) or finished (success).
    SettingsCard
    A settings row: an icon, a title with a description, and a control on the right (a switch, a combo box, a button...).
    Severity
    Severity of an info bar, snackbar or status icon.
    Snackbar
    Brief messages that appear at the bottom of a window and go away by themselves.
    SplitButton
    A button with a main action and a drop-down menu of alternatives.
    Symbol
    The glyph catalog of Tessel (the same names as Tessel4J's Symbol and Tessel.js).
    TabView
    Closable, reorderable document tabs.
    TabView.Tab
    One tab of a TabView.
    TabView.TabViewListener
    Reports what happens to the tabs.
    TeachingTip
    A popover with a tail that points at a control, to explain a feature.
    TeachingTip.CloseReason
    Why a tip was closed.
    TeachingTip.Placement
    Which side of the target the tip appears on.
    Tessel
    Entry point of Tessel for JavaFX: installs the theme, switches between light, dark and system themes at runtime, and offers a few styling helpers.
    TesselDialog
    A dialog window with the Tessel chrome (title bar, rounded frame, shadow) and no minimize or maximize button.
    TesselFileChooser
    A file chooser dialog in the Tessel style, with the API of FileChooser (which opens a native operating system dialog that no theme can change).
    TesselSliderSkin
    The skin Tessel gives every Slider (through the style sheet): the standard slider plus an accent-colored fill from the start of the track to the thumb.
    TesselTheme
    The color theme of an application.
    TesselWindow
    A window with Tessel's own title bar: the icon, the title, any components you add, and minimize / maximize / close buttons, inside a rounded, shadowed frame.
    TextBlock
    A wrapping label with a TextStyle from the Tessel type ramp.
    TextStyle
    Typography ramp.
    ToggleSwitch
    An on/off switch with an optional label.
